calc.title: Generator kVA Calculator
calc.teaserTitle: What size generator do you need?
calc.teaserBody: Enter your load or pick your site type. We add the right safety margin and match you to real units from our catalog.
calc.pfHelp: Power factor is the ratio of real power (kW) to apparent power (kVA). Mixed commercial and industrial loads are typically around 0.8 — the standard rating point for diesel generators. Use 0.8 unless you have measured data.
calc.marginHelp: We add 20–25% because motors draw 5–7× their running current when starting, Gulf heat (45–50 °C) reduces engine output, and sites usually grow. Much more than that and the engine runs under-loaded, which causes wet-stacking.
calc.noMatch: No catalog unit covers this exact rating — our engineers will propose a custom or synchronised solution.
calc.overRange: Above 2500 kVA we recommend synchronising multiple generators. Our team will design the plant.
calc.disclaimer: Indicative sizing only. An engineer will confirm against your actual load list before quoting.
calc.invalid: Enter a load greater than zero.
